newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 13-wk T-bills yield 20 pct, undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Czech 13-wk T-bills yield 20 pct, undersubscribed.

text.p: Gross yield in a Czech National Bank auction on Wednesday of 13-week treasury bills was 20 percent, and the offer of 10 billion crowns was undersubscribed with 4.507 billion crowns in bids accepted, the CNB said.
It said the remainder of the volume of the finance ministry issue on offer was purchased by the CNB and put into the central bank's portfolio.

In the last auction of 13-week T-bills in April, yield was 11.6 percent, but that was before heavy speculative pressure on the Czech crown in May forced the central bank to tighten liquidity on the interbank money market.
Meanwhile the Finance Ministry has been short of funds for public sector wages in recent days, and has tapped the money market to close the gaps.
